title: Silenced by Design: Censorship, Governance, and the Politics of Access in Generative AI Refusal Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of refusal and censorship behaviors across multiple LLMs (Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) using prompts that request summaries of politically sensitive and geopolitical materials (specifically, reports on the use of AI in the Gaza war).
